evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Nicole: 'This call will just take around ten to fifteen minutes.' — time-boxed but no explicit 'you can walk away with a quote you can depend on' promise, and no clear wait for yes before continuing.
evidence_quotes.discovery_basics: Nicole confirms moving date (Saturday November 21st) and asks about concerns. Asked about packing separately (separate days for packing/moving), but never explicitly asked customer's name, city-to-city route, or approximate home size before pivoting to walkthrough offer.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Nicole: 'I'd like to ask first what are your biggest concerns and what are the most important things you want answers to on this call today?' — asked before probing starts.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Veronica raises three concerns (cost estimate, ensuring movers are great, handling heavy pieces). Nicole responds with 'Mm-hmm' three times but does not dig deeper with follow-up questions like 'tell me more about that' — instead pivots immediately to the walkthrough offer.
evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: No summary reflection offered. Nicole does not say 'So what I'm hearing is...' or confirm back what was raised.
evidence_quotes.walkthrough_branch: Nicole correctly identifies a large move and offers the virtual walkthrough: 'Usually, based on the size of your home plus packing service. We do a virtual walkthrough, it's just like a video call on your preferred time and date.' Walkthrough is scheduled for Friday September 25th at 2:00 PM, and the call routes cleanly to that next step with no abandonment.

top_strength: Nicole correctly identified this as a large-move scenario and cleanly routed to a virtual walkthrough without pricing on the call, following the script intent for moves that need in-person assessment.
coaching_note: When the customer raised three specific concerns (cost, mover quality, handling heavy pieces), Nicole acknowledged but never dug deeper — add one follow-up question per concern raised to understand the customer's real priority before routing to the walkthrough.
